_format: Each line is one Chatterbox take. Tokens split on spaces. [shown=spoken] gives a spoken form. Suffix *y = yellow keyword, *r = red keyword. A trailing / ends a caption phrase. fx: radio = PA speaker, janitor / mimic / friend = pitch-shifted character voices (from the narrator's take). pause = silence after the line (s).
title: AFTER HOURS Day 1
